correctness.rationale: On the support E_m of three complete m-by-m blocks plus cyclic successor matchings, Y=1/(m+1) on support is bistochastic and strictly interior to the face, and strictly negative off-support multipliers give a real local affine projection cell. Its derivative is the cycle-space orthogonal projector Q=I-D^T(DD^T)^+D. The six explicitly given potential groups solve every Laplacian equation for the special matching dipole, yielding exact row absolute mass Lambda_m=2(3m²+m−1)/((m+1)(m+2)). Taking input signs of that row attains the local amplification, and a common all-ones shift makes both observations strictly positive without changing projections. The full-support derivative has norm 4(1−1/n)²; the positive-coefficient m−4 polynomial proves strict advantage exactly from m=4 in this family, limit 6 vs 4. A fresh exact rational reconstruction for m=2..11 verifies every Kirchhoff equation and row mass, while all-m formula follows symbolic identities.
